Entity.name: Past due financial asset instrument
Entity.commentInRDBMS: Past due financial instrument is an Financial asset instrument whose payments are late, or past due.

Attribute.name: Arrears for the instrument
Attribute.comment: Arrears for the instrument is the aggregate amount of principal, interest and any fee payment outstanding at the reporting date, which is contractually due and has not been paid (past due) for the Financial asset instrument. This amount is always to be reported. '0' is to be reported if the instrument was not past due on the reporting date.

Attribute.name: Date past due
Attribute.comment: Date past due is the date on which the Financial asset instrument became past due in accordance with Part 2.48 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014. This is the latest such date prior to the reporting reference date and it is to be reported if the instrument is past due on the reporting reference date.

Attribute.name: Freezing period in days
Attribute.comment: Freezing period in days is the number of days (if any) for which the freezing period of the Past due financial asset instrument has been applied, in accordance with EBA guidelines 2016/07 paragraph 18.
